args.title: Persist export format selection in localStorage
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Persist the selected export format in localStorage so that when users change the format in the dropdown, their preference is remembered across page reloads and new visits to a report.

file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component does not persist the user's selected export format to localStorage, causing the selection to reset on reload.
